concept: A program deployed at a permissionless account address makes the account executable, which blocks a required mutable-account step and partially stops a multisig.
scene: Technical diagram on a dark navy background: a multisig box on the left connected by an arrow to a ProposalActivate step. A blocked amber marker sits on the arrow where an executable account is passed as mutable. A second path labeled skip drafting bypasses the block, drawn as a thinner line.
alt_text: Diagram of a multisig whose ProposalActivate step is blocked by an executable permissionless account, while a skip-drafting path still works.
